amounts.context: Overtime reduction for the pilot group

classification.rationale: An evaluation report with purpose, method, findings and recommendations for a software pilot.

summarization.headline: The LedgerLoop invoice-matching pilot cut processing time and errors at a licence cost of USD 250,000.
key_points: Overtime for the pilot group fell by $18,400.
summarization.title: Pilot Evaluation Report: Automated Invoice Matching at Harbor Logistics Ltd.
key_findings: Processing time per invoice fell from 9 minutes to 4 minutes
Matching errors dropped from 3.1% to 1.2% of invoices
The tool struggled with handwritten delivery notes
recommendations: Request a written price quote from LedgerLoop before any decision
Extend the pilot to a third clerk for one more month
